blockers.reason: The authorized semantic row names create_wrong_render_directory_member but supplies no basename or evidence-relative parent. The verifier would reject any nested row directory with NESTED_ROW_ENTRY, but choosing a concrete member such as rows/row-000/render would invent an unauthorized discriminant.

Every sibling schedule identity is recomputed from [run_name, ordinal, slot, cell] and checked by SIBLING_IDENTITY_DERIVATION before GLOBAL_IDENTITY_COLLISION. Mutating a nonce or backend identity therefore fails derivation first; reaching the collision check while retaining valid derivation requires a SHA-256 collision or duplicate directory name. No exact authorized mutation can provide either.

These obligations mutate the four-part component or pinned shared-authority sources, not a copied subject evidence tree. The required checkpoint and architecture-schema pointers are not identified by the authorized regression rows or evidence schemas. They require a separately authorized SOURCE_IDENTITY_MUTATION_COPY controller binding.
